title: Mercedes Actros FUPS Bullbar #15
description: Actros FUPS high tensile aluminium Bullbar. 76mm (88mm option) one piece cross tubes through drilled uprights. Contoured main channel, provision available for radar. Tow pin and heavy duty steel backing plate, optional hi-tensile aluminium backing plate (save 83kg). Front mudflap mounts. Maximum protection for the long run. Indicator repeater lights to outer channel return. Optional poly-carbonate headlight covers.
